presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.description: What clients are told when they connect to this endpoint, and how its tool list is shaped. Applies to MCP connections (Streamable HTTP and SSE); the OpenAPI view of the endpoint is not affected. Leave everything empty to serve the endpoint exactly as before.
presentation.loadFailed: The presentation settings could not be read.
presentation.killSwitch: This gateway has endpoint presentation turned off (MCP_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION), so settings saved here are kept but not applied.
presentation.leanStoredNotServed: A lean listing is stored for this endpoint, but this gateway version does not serve it. Saving resets it to the full list.
presentation.titlePlaceholder: A short name clients can show
presentation.titleHelp: Sent to every client at connection as the server title. One line, up to 80 characters. Do not put secrets or client data here.
presentation.instructionsPlaceholder: Guidance for the model, such as which tools to prefer and what to avoid
presentation.instructionsHelp: Sent to every client at connection, and read by models. Do not put secrets or client data here. The text is also kept in the audit log, which cannot be edited later.
presentation.omitLabel: Leave output schemas out of the tool list
presentation.omitHelp: Smaller tool lists for clients that load every tool up front. Clients that read output schemas will not see them. Tool results are not changed.
presentation.timing: Changes apply to sessions that start after you save. Clients that are already connected keep what they started with.
presentation.auditNote: Each save is recorded in the audit log with the text as saved.

requireScopedApiKeyDescription: Only accept API keys scoped to this endpoint; reject gateway-wide (unscoped) keys. Applies to API-key auth only — OAuth access is unaffected.
restrictedDescription: When on, only administrators and members of a mapped access group reach this endpoint over OAuth. Turning it on also requires endpoint-scoped API keys, so unscoped gateway-wide keys are rejected too.
